core_question: Did the state violate investor expectations or deny basic fairness?
typical_claim: Arbitrary conduct denial of justice lack of transparency
regulatory_sovereignty_issue: Can tribunals review ordinary regulatory change as unfair treatment?

core_question: Did regulation substantially deprive the investor of investment value?
typical_claim: Environmental health tax or land-use measures
regulatory_sovereignty_issue: When does public regulation become compensable taking?

core_question: Was the foreign investor treated less favorably than comparable domestic actors?
typical_claim: Discriminatory licensing taxation procurement or enforcement
regulatory_sovereignty_issue: How should tribunals identify valid comparators and public-interest distinctions?

core_question: Was the investor denied treatment available to investors from another state?
typical_claim: Importing procedural or substantive protections from other treaties
regulatory_sovereignty_issue: Can MFN clauses expand dispute settlement or treaty protections beyond negotiated text?

core_question: Did breach of a state contract become a treaty breach?
typical_claim: Concession infrastructure privatization or procurement disputes
regulatory_sovereignty_issue: When should contract disputes be internationalized?

core_question: Did the state fail to protect the investment from physical or legal harm?
typical_claim: Violence unrest infrastructure insecurity or enforcement failure
regulatory_sovereignty_issue: How far does due diligence extend during social conflict or crisis?
